description: One covered stock's valuation: the current price, the headline model value and how far the price is from it ("overvalued by 5% vs model"), every other model's value with its range, the valuation profile that chose the headline model, the discount rate inputs, and its Quant and Valuation grades (a letter with the model and the date). SweetValueLab model output, recomputed nightly from public filings and end-of-day prices. Not real-time quotes, not investment advice.

ticker.description: The stock's ticker, e.g. "NVDA". Use search_stocks first when unsure.

name: get_stock_valuation
title: Stock valuation vs models
